vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-45853
vulnerability.description: MiniZip in zlib through 1.3 has an integer overflow and resultant heap-based buffer overflow in zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64 via a long filename, comment, or extra field.

statements.impact_statement: zt-orders runs on distroless Python runtime (FastAPI/uvicorn) and never invokes MiniZip archive creation functions (zipOpenNewFileInZip4_64). Container is further isolated via readOnlyRootFilesystem and Cilium default-deny.
